jobs.title: Director, Sales
jobs.description_text: Our Company Welcome to Energy Vault® (NYSE:NRGV), a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets. Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world. Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security. By combining asset ownership with advanced technologies and integration expertise, Energy Vault is building the next generation of critical energy infrastructure, delivering dependable power when and where it matters most. jobs.description_text: Rigetti is seeking a motivated research intern to support superconducting qubit fabrication at Mevell NanoLab cleanroom at UC Berkeley. jobs.description_text: Zoox is building the world’s first purpose-built autonomous robotaxi. Fleet Operations keeps that fleet available, utilized, and safe, from 24/7 remote assistance and rider support to maintenance, repair, and on-road operations. It is an operational training leadership job: you will run the function that certifies Crew to perform safety-critical work and keeps them current as the product, processes, and geographic footprint scale. The scope spans two training surfaces that must run to the same bar: Remote operations: This looks and feels like a high-stakes contact center: nested coaching, certification before live work, quality-driven upskilling, and trainer-to-learner ratios that have to hold as hiring ramps. Ground operations: All the on-the-ground work that it takes to operate our fleet, along with the training programs to enable our R&D Operations. This includes blended e-learning and hands-on and vehicle-in-the-loop training, with dedicated training vehicles and site infrastructure. As Program Manager, Response, you own the Response program end to end and lead the centralized dispatch team that runs it. You will not lead crews in the field — market leadership owns field execution. You own dispatch, the recovery vendor network, the metric set, and the standards that make Response work the same way in Las Vegas as it does in Atlanta. This is a builder's role in a program scaling toward a national footprint without scaling headcount at the same rate, and you will spend as much time designing how the work should be done as you will running it.
